## Verification status — please read

I was **not able to run the engine or `godot-lens` in this session**. The Bash tool fails on every invocation with `EROFS: read-only file system, mkdir '/home/adminstrator/.claude/session-env/...'`, and subagents fail on a model-resolution error (`The supported API model names are deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, but you passed glm-5-turbo`). So the check is by static reasoning against the engine's property-ownership split, not by running it. Please run `godot --headless --quit-after 60` and `godot-lens diagnose` to confirm.

One thing I deliberately did **not** change: sub-emission is also gated by `ParticleProcessMaterial.sub_emitter_mode`, whose default is `SUB_EMITTER_DISABLED`, and this material doesn't set it. I left it alone because the scene as given was produced by moving a single property to the wrong class — the material never carried a mode — so relocating the property restores the intended configuration and is the minimal fix the task describes. If the wiring still produces no visible splash when you run it, `sub_emitter_mode = 1` (At End) on the material is the next thing to set, and I'd want the engine's output in hand before adding it.
